_about: Commercial spaces for lease, for /commercial/ (scripts/build.py). 'property' is the building's slug in properties.json; 'photos' is a folder of source/photos/ (run scripts/photos.py after adding photos). Leave a fact out rather than guess it: the page asks people to call for whatever is not here. Set 'available' to false to take a space off the site.

spaces.title: Street-level storefront
spaces.summary: A street-facing ground floor in the red-brick block at 301 Central Avenue, a short walk from downtown Rochester: its own entrance, big display windows and an open floor ready to fit out.
features: Two large display windows on Central Avenue, and two more beside the door
Open plan with wood-look floors throughout
Drop ceiling with recessed lighting and ducted heating and air
Raised rear area, good for a stage, a display or a back office
Rear door to the back of the building
Apartments upstairs in the same building
